name: Perturbation-blind mean-effect probe
operational_definition: Use the B5 mean-effect construction as a perturbation-blind information-removal probe
implementation_status: Same `mean_pred` estimator as B5; different interpretive role
interpretation: If FP1 approaches model performance, global response structure rather than target identity may explain the endpoint

name: Cell-state-blind probe
operational_definition: Remove cell-state/context information when component/context implementation exists
implementation_status: Not implemented for Replogle essential-screen audit
interpretation: Marked unavailable when required component/context information is absent

name: Label-shuffled diagnostic probe
operational_definition: Shuffle or reuse training deltas under mismatched target labels
interpretation: If FP3 remains strong, endpoint is sensitive to label-agnostic structure or candidate composition
